answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by requiring every identity to seal a unique crystal of successive work proofs into a shared threshold vault. Each new epoch adds a shale layer of prior attestations that must be sequentially re-solved before the crystal can authorize emission. An attacker forging a fake must expend fresh sequential compute equal to the full shale depth for that head; parallel farm heads cannot share the work because each crystal is bound to one vault share, so marginal cost scales with every additional identity rather than being amortized.
